th-siam-elephant.title: Flag of Siam (White Elephant)
desc:
- The Kingdom of Siam (1855–1916) used a red field with a white elephant in the centre — one of the most distinctive historical flags of Southeast Asia
- **Construction:** a red field bearing a white elephant in profile, facing the hoist
- Used as the national flag of Siam before the adoption of the current tricolour in 1917
trivia:
- Thailand (formerly Siam) used the white elephant symbol historically
- The elephant represented royal power and Buddhist sacred traditions
- Still used in Thai royal symbolism and heraldry
